units: <cite ref="Eruvin 101a:10">Erub. 101ᵃ</cite> it is written about you (Jews) <he>טובם כח׳</he> (<cite ref="Micah 7:4">Mic. VII, 4</cite>) the best among them is like a thorn.

senses.gloss: anything used for filling a gap, stop-gap.—Pl. חֲדָקִים, חֲדָקִין, הֲ׳. Ib. כשם שח׳ וכ׳ (Ms. O. שה׳) as the stop-gaps protect the breach &c.—Ib. X, 8 (101ᵃ) וח׳ שבפרצה (Bab. ed. חוֹדְקִים, Ms. M. הדקין, Var. חרקין, חורקין, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) and the stop-gaps in a breach.
